IMPORTANT: default NLOOP=8 was NOT enough here -- TLBOT kept drifting colder with a GROWING per-loop delta (0.51K at loop2 up to 0.87K at loop8, i.e. still accelerating, not decaying). Re-ran spin-up with NLOOP=40: TLBOT decays smoothly through loop 15, then LOCKS to an exact fixed point from loop 16 onward (delta=0.00000, loops 16-40 identical to 5 decimal places) -- a genuine, if unusually shaped, convergence, not a runaway. Scored run re-seeded from the loop-40 (fully converged) restart, not the original loop-8 attempt. Result: AvgSurfT 289.1-301.8K (16.0-28.6C) with real seasonal range (highland Ethiopia, 1783m), TLBOT rock-stable at 277.13-277.23K, no ice. LESSON: always check scripts/check_spinup_convergence.py's actual trend before accepting NLOOP=8 -- a lake deep enough to stratify (here LDEPTH=10m) can need far more loops, and the failure mode (still-growing delta) looks nothing like Ladoga's smoothly-decaying one, so eyeball the numbers, don't just check whether delta is small at the last loop shown.

IMPORTANT, UNRESOLVED: at LDEPTH=70m (by far the deepest candidate), spin-up does NOT converge within any loop count tried. Checked out to 65 loops (see repo_scaffold memory for the full per-loop trace): TLBOT increases by a near-CONSTANT ~0.065-0.066 K every single loop from loop 2 through loop 65, with NO decay -- a sustained linear drift, not an exponential approach to equilibrium (contrast Tana's clearly-decaying-then-locking pattern). Plausibly reflects real, very-long deep-water equilibration timescales for a lake this large/deep, poorly suited to a 'repeat one identical year' spin-up technique. HOWEVER: the near-surface state that matters for LSWT benchmarking (AvgSurfT, TLWML) drifts ~17x slower than TLBOT (~0.004-0.005 K/loop, also not fully decaying but far smaller in absolute terms) -- so this mostly affects the deep bottom-water diagnostic, not the satellite-comparable surface temperature. Scored run seeded from a 40-loop state as a pragmatic, DOCUMENTED-CAVEAT choice, not a fully-converged one. Result (still physically sane): AvgSurfT 295.9-302.3K (22.7-29.2C), no ice, HLML 0.8-11.4m. Revisit if TLBOT/deep-water fidelity turns out to matter for this lake's specific benchmarking use case -- e.g. by using a real multi-year forcing sequence to spin up instead of one repeated year, rather than more loops of the same year.
